catalog_purpose: Curated defensive attack cards for synthetic payment-security simulations only.

cards.name: GenAI-amplified authorized push payment scam
cards.observed_pattern: A victim is manipulated into authorizing a payment to a newly introduced beneficiary. GenAI can increase personalization, language quality, channel consistency, and campaign scale, while the simulator represents only defensive metadata and payment behavior.
genai_role: Personalizes social-engineering themes at scale
Maintains consistent personas across simulated channels
Adapts urgency and pretext categories without generating message content

source_refs.title: Mastercard — Generative AI: Preparing Your Fraud Organization
source_refs.observed: GenAI changes both fraud enablement and fraud defense across the user transaction journey.

source_refs.title: FinCEN Alert on Fraud Schemes Involving Deepfake Media
source_refs.observed: FinCEN identifies authorized push payment fraud among schemes associated with GenAI-enabled identities.

cards.name: GenAI-assisted account takeover and rapid transfer
cards.observed_pattern: An existing account develops a novel session or authentication context, adds or uses a beneficiary, and rapidly initiates transfers. The laboratory starts after compromise and never creates credentials, phishing pages, or contact content.
genai_role: Improves impersonation consistency in the pre-transaction phase
Scales targeting and pretext variation
Adapts observable transaction timing after defensive feedback

source_refs.title: FBI IC3 — Account Takeover Fraud via Impersonation of Financial Institution Support
source_refs.observed: The FBI describes support impersonation leading to unauthorized account access and rapid movement of funds.

source_refs.title: Mastercard — Generative AI: Preparing Your Fraud Organization
source_refs.observed: Organizations should evaluate GenAI-related vulnerabilities across the user transaction journey.

cards.name: GenAI-enhanced supplier impersonation payment diversion
cards.observed_pattern: A business payment is redirected after an apparent supplier-profile change and an urgent invoice request. The simulator stores only channel-risk summaries and transactional observables, never emails, voices, or impersonation content.
genai_role: Makes simulated business personas and tone more consistent
Supports multilingual pretext categories
Varies urgency and relationship context at campaign scale

source_refs.title: FBI IC3 — Business Email Compromise: The $55 Billion Scam
source_refs.observed: BEC schemes compromise or impersonate business communications to conduct unauthorized transfers of funds.

source_refs.title: Mastercard — Generative AI: Preparing Your Fraud Organization
source_refs.observed: GenAI can empower fraudsters and also support defenses across payment journeys.

cards.name: AI-coordinated mule-network fan-in and dispersal
cards.observed_pattern: Multiple synthetic accounts receive funds and redistribute value in a short period, creating graph and velocity patterns associated with funnel or mule activity. No real accounts, recruitment content, or payment rails are used.
genai_role: Coordinates diverse synthetic account-behavior profiles
Varies campaign timing and graph shape
Uses Referee feedback to mutate bounded graph observables

source_refs.title: Reserve Bank of India Bulletin — MuleHunter.ai
source_refs.observed: RBI describes an AI and machine-learning approach for identifying mule bank accounts using account and transaction patterns.

source_refs.title: FinCEN Alert on Fraud Schemes Involving Deepfake Media
source_refs.observed: FinCEN describes fraudulent accounts and funnel accounts receiving and laundering fraud proceeds.

cards.name: GenAI synthetic-identity onboarding and payment activation
cards.observed_pattern: A synthetic applicant attempts identity verification, opens an account, builds limited history, and later initiates payment activity. The lab emits only numerical consistency, linkage, liveness, and behavior indicators—never identity documents or personal data.
genai_role: Creates variation in synthetic identity consistency signals
Scales onboarding attempts in a closed laboratory
Adapts account-aging and activity patterns within approved bounds

source_refs.title: FinCEN Alert on Fraud Schemes Involving Deepfake Media
source_refs.observed: FinCEN reports GenAI-altered identity media, synthetic identities, fraudulent account opening, coordinated accounts, and rapid transactions.

source_refs.title: Mastercard — Generative AI: Preparing Your Fraud Organization
source_refs.observed: GenAI introduces risks and defensive opportunities throughout customer and transaction journeys.

cards.name: Feedback-guided low-and-slow payment evasion
cards.observed_pattern: A previously generated synthetic campaign is replayed with only approved parameters changed in response to coarse Referee feedback. It tests whether defenses recognize the underlying behavior as obvious indicators are reduced.
genai_role: Selects a bounded campaign objective and stage emphasis
Interprets coarse non-sensitive Referee categories
Proposes variants that the deterministic mutation controller constrains

source_refs.title: Mastercard — Generative AI: Preparing Your Fraud Organization
source_refs.observed: Fraud organizations should continuously adapt as GenAI changes both attack and defense capabilities.

source_refs.title: FinCEN Alert on Fraud Schemes Involving Deepfake Media
source_refs.observed: FinCEN lists coordinated activity, transaction velocity, payee risk, and rapid outflow as useful risk indicators.

cards.name: GenAI-assisted merchant payout destination manipulation
cards.observed_pattern: A synthetic merchant profile develops a plausible operational history, changes its payout destination, shows an unusual sales pattern, and requests settlement to the newly introduced destination. GenAI is represented through bounded automation and consistency signals rather than executable abuse instructions.
genai_role: Coordinates plausible merchant-profile changes across synthetic events
Varies sales and payout timing within approved bounds
Adapts observable consistency while the Referee retains sealed truth

source_refs.title: Mastercard — Generative AI: Preparing Your Fraud Organization
source_refs.observed: The report recommends layered detection across the customer and transaction lifecycle, including behavioral and identity signals.

source_refs.title: FinCEN Alert on Fraud Schemes Involving Deepfake Media
source_refs.observed: FinCEN highlights identity inconsistencies, velocity, related accounts, and rapid movement of funds as defensive indicators.

cards.name: GenAI-assisted dispute evidence and refund abuse
cards.observed_pattern: A completed synthetic purchase is followed by a coordinated dispute, machine-like evidence submission, conflicting case facts, and a refund attempt. The scenario tests post-transaction investigation and containment without producing deceptive documents or message content.
genai_role: Scales synthetic dispute submissions without generating usable documents
Introduces bounded evidence-consistency and behavioral signals
Adapts timing and linked-case volume against post-transaction controls

source_refs.title: Mastercard — Generative AI: Preparing Your Fraud Organization
source_refs.observed: The report treats fraud defense as a lifecycle problem and calls for stronger post-event analysis, operational readiness, and continuous learning.

source_refs.title: FinCEN Alert on Fraud Schemes Involving Deepfake Media
source_refs.observed: The alert recommends examining inconsistencies across submitted evidence, identity information, accounts, and transaction behavior.

cards.name: Agentic-commerce intent and checkout manipulation
cards.observed_pattern: An automated shopping agent presents partially credible identity, consumer-intent, and payment-container signals, then attempts a bounded purchase sequence whose basket or payment scope may differ from the verified instruction. The simulation contains only synthetic trust metadata and payment events.
genai_role: Coordinates synthetic browsing, intent, and checkout behavior across an agentic purchase journey
Adapts how closely agent identity and transaction intent resemble legitimate commerce
Tests whether defense verifies agent, consent, and payment scope as one linked sequence

source_refs.title: Mastercard Agent Pay — secure and trusted agentic payments
source_refs.observed: Mastercard identifies registered agents, network tokens, verified order intent, and consumer consent as foundations for trusted agentic payments.

source_refs.title: Mastercard — The new rules of the road for agentic commerce
source_refs.observed: Agentic-commerce protocols emphasize clear user intent, secure credentials, verifiable agent identity, and low-friction authentication.

source_refs.title: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol — Merchant Specifications
source_refs.observed: The specification separates agent recognition, consumer recognition, and payment-container verification and includes freshness and replay controls.
